samples.name: Login only (Smart Books)
samples.prompt: Login only to Smart Books. Verify the login form accepts credentials and the app loads after sign-in. Do not run any other modules until login succeeds.

samples.name: Error pack (Books sandbox)
samples.prompt: Run the Books sandbox error pack: accounting reconciliation, reports, deterministic File I/O correctness, console failures and unhandled API errors. Skip UX, theme and keyboard checks. Feature and UX checks belong on smoke.aicountly.org.

samples.name: Full functional run (Books sandbox)
samples.prompt: Run a full functional QA on Books sandbox. Create deterministic ledgers, items, sales/purchase vouchers, payments, receipts. Test deterministic File I/O after approval. Open ledger, registers, GST reports, trial balance, P&L and balance sheet. Verify all totals against expected results. Capture screenshots, trace, console and network. Skip UX/theme/keyboard; feature and UX checks belong on smoke.aicountly.org.

samples.name: GST reconciliation only (Books sandbox)
samples.prompt: Focus on GST. Create sales and purchase vouchers, then validate GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and HSN summary against expected output/input GST. Skip permission and keyboard sessions.
